mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh's agro-climatic zone listing: 1. The zones continue to be listed against the 13 old districts. 2. They have been fully re-cut according to the April 2022 district reorganisation. 3. Andhra Pradesh now has 28 districts. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: odd phrase 'according to the cited current reference'

pyq_bad.why: wrong options: no correct option (AP has six zones); APPSC withdrew the question

patterns: APPSC asks the count and names of AP's six agro-climatic zones, typically as 'which is NOT a zone' with a fake zone (Low altitude) as the trap.
Zone-district matching appears (PYQ pair Southern Zone -> Nellore).
Other PSCs ask India-level counts: Planning Commission's 15 agro-climatic zones.
App MCQs add RARS headquarters, crops and 2024-26 rainfall data that go beyond PYQ depth but are sound.
